pages.text: Welcome to Crossroads! This book is a guidebook for both Crossroads & $(l:essentials:essentials/welcome)Essentials/$.$(br2)Crossroads is a mod about complex automation.

pages.title: Crossroads!
pages.text: An industrial chemistry setup mass-producing lab-grown diamonds

Almost everything in the mod can be automated with the tools Crossroads adds, which are usually simple single-purpose tools that can be assembled into Rube Goldberg machines that end up being the best way to do things.$(br2)In this section of the book, you'll get a broad introduction to various systems in the mod. All the information in these entries are also in the respective guide categories, but it should be easiest to understand as a beginner from this section.$(br2)Crossroads has a lot of different energy systems and mechanics, and more will unlock as you get farther in the mod.
